newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Hardeman County, Tenn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Hardeman County, Tenn..

text.p: Notice is hereby given that the County Executive of Hardeman County, Tennessee (the County'') will receive sealed bids only for the purchase of the County's $7,000,000 School Bonds, Series 1997 (the Bonds''), all or none, until 10:00 o'clock, a.m., C.S.T., on
at the offices of the County Executive, Hardeman County Courthouse, Bolivar, Tennessee. The Bonds shall be sold at a rate or rates not exceeding seven percent (7%) per annum.

The sale may be postponed upon notice given by Munifacts News Wire not less than twenty-four hours prior to the time bids are to be received. If the postponement occurs, the sale will be held at the time and date announced via Munifacts News Wire at least forty-eight hours before the sale. The Bonds will be dated January 15, 1997. The Bonds will mature on April 1 in the years 1998 through 2024, inclusive. No bid will be considered for less than ninety- nine percent (99%) of par and accrued interest. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder whose bid results in the lowest true interest rate on the Bonds. The Bonds will be awarded on the sale date by the County Executive.

Bonds maturing April 1, 2008 and thereafter are subject to optional redemption on April 1, 2007 and thereafter as provided in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The printed Bonds and approving opinion of Stokes & Bartholomew, P.A.,
Nashville, Tennessee will be furnished at the expense of the County. Additional information, including the Official

Statement and Detailed Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the undersigned at the Hardeman County Courthouse, Bolivar, Tennessee 38008, or from J.C. Bradford & Co., Attn: Tom McAnulty, 330 Commerce Street, Nashville, Tennessee 37201, telephone (615) 748-9291.
